answer: Each submission hangs on the island of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The kernel of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
